나와 상대가 가위바위보를 여러 판 한다. 두 사람이 동시에 가위, 바위,: The opponent and I play several rounds of rock-paper-scissors. The two people each throw one of scissors, rock, or paper at the same time. Scissors beats paper, rock beats scissors, paper beats rock. If they throw the same thing, it is a tie.

The opponent and I play several rounds of rock-paper-scissors. The two people each throw one of scissors, rock, or paper at the same time. Paper beats scissors, scissors beats rock, rock beats paper. If they throw the same thing, it is a tie.
상대는 둘째 판부터 늘 이렇게 손을 낸다: 자기가 직전 판에 낸 손을 다:
From the second round on, the opponent always throws their hand like this: they throw again the hand they threw in the previous round.
Record so far:
Round 1: me rock, opponent paper
다음 판에 상대가 낼 손은?: Which hand will the opponent throw in the next round?
상대는 둘째 판부터 늘 이렇게 손을 낸다: 자기가 직전 판에 낸 손을 이:
From the second round on, the opponent always throws their hand like this: they throw the hand that beats the hand they threw in the previous round.
Record so far:
Round 1: me scissors, opponent rock
다음 판에 내가 이기려면 무엇을 내야 하는가?: What must I throw to win in the next round?
상대는 둘째 판부터 늘 이렇게 손을 낸다: 내가 직전 판에 낸 손에 지는:
From the second round on, the opponent always throws their hand like this: they throw the hand that loses to the hand I threw in the previous round.
Record so far:
Round 1: me scissors, opponent paper
상대는 둘째 판부터 늘 아래 방식 중 하나만 따라 손을 낸다. 어느 방식:
From the second round on, the opponent always throws their hand following only one of the methods below. Which method it is has not been revealed.
(a) They throw again the hand they threw in the previous round.
(b) They throw the hand that beats the hand they threw in the previous round.
(c) They throw the hand that loses to the hand they threw in the previous round.
(d) They copy the hand I threw in the previous round.
(e) They throw the hand that beats the hand I threw in the previous round.
(f) They throw the hand that loses to the hand I threw in the previous round.
(g) If they won in the previous round, they throw the same hand again, and if they lost or tied, they throw the hand that beats the hand they threw in the previous round.
Record so far:
Round 1: me scissors, opponent scissors
Round 2: me rock, opponent rock
Round 3: me rock, opponent paper
Round 4: me scissors, opponent scissors
Round 5: me scissors, opponent rock
